title: Among the account opened, how many female customers who were born before 19
question:
Among the account opened, how many female customers who were born before 1950 and stayed in Sokolov?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: Customers refer to clients; Female refers to gender = 'F'; Names of districts appear in column A2

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.XCL_012 = d.XCL_017
JOIN disp dp ON c.XCL_009 = dp.XCL_014
JOIN account a ON dp.XCL_015 = a.XCL_001
WHERE c.XCL_010 = 'F'
  AND c.XCL_011 < '1950-01-01'
  AND d.XCL_018 = 'Sokolov'
